name: suganthan-gsc-mcp
description: Ask Claude real questions about your Google Search Console data. SEO analysis tools, local and private. TradyList fork: host-locked submissions.
long_description: A Google Search Console MCP server that answers questions, not API rows: quick win keywords, traffic drops, content decay, cannibalisation, CTR benchmarks, multi site dashboards, and image search analytics. This fork does not fetch arbitrary URLs, write reports to disk, or request de-indexing. URL and sitemap submission are limited to allowlisted hosts. Runs entirely on your machine: your data goes straight from this computer to Google and nothing passes through anyone else's servers.

access_level.title: Access level
access_level.description: readonly (recommended) or submit. Submit adds Indexing API URL_UPDATED and sitemap submission. full is an alias of submit.

secrets_file.title: Google OAuth client secrets JSON
secrets_file.description: Path to your OAuth client secrets file. Needed until built in Google sign in ships; see the README quick start.
